newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Qantas domestic share up in September.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Qantas domestic share up in September.

text.p: Qantas Airways Ltd's share of Australian domestic traffic rose in September at the expense of competitor Ansett Australia, the Transport Department said.
Qantas carried 53.6 percent of all domestic passengers in September, with Ansett holding the remainder.
"Department of Transport figures released today show that the Qantas domestic market share was up 0.2 percentage points over the figure for September 1995," Qantas said in a statement.
In August Qantas's share was a record 54.3 percent.
Qantas said its total revenue passenger kilometres for September 1996 was six percent higher than for September 1995.
The airline said its market share for the first quarter of the 1996/97 financial year was 53.9 percent.
Qantas is 25 percent owned by British Airways Plc.
Ansett is owned equally by News Corp and Air New Zealand Ltd.
